inlineSql: Select * From TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' and LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TABLE_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TABLE_NAME As CounterL,TABLE_CODE as CodeL FROM TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.VCH_TIME DESC
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT * FROM PRINT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PRINT_TYPE = 'QR' ORDER BY PRINT_FILE
SELECT * FROM PRINT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PRINT_TYPE = 'TAG' ORDER BY PRINT_FILE

' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' and VCH_SRNO = ?
SELECT * FROM IMAGE_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?
SELECT * FROM TAG_PRINT_DATA

SELECT A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,B.AC_NAME As PartyNameL FROM BAR_CAN_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,B.AC_NAME ORDER BY A.VCH_NO

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM (BAR_CAN_DETL AS C INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS A ON C.CO_CODE = A.CO_CODE AND C.TAG_NO = A.TAG_NO AND C.VCH_SRNO = A.VCH_SRNO) LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND C.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND C.VCH_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY C.SR_NO
Select * From BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '

SELECT B.BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK UNION ALL SELECT C.BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,C.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM BOOK_DATA AS C WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.CO_BOOK = '140' GROUP BY C.BOOK_NAME,C.CO_BOOK ORDER BY B.BOOK_NAME
Select * From GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.GR_NAME As GrNameL,A.GR_CODE as GrCodeL,A.GR_TYPE as TypeL,A.TRAD_TYPE As TradTypeL FROM GROUP_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.GR_NAME,A.GR_CODE,A.GR_TYPE,A.TRAD_TYPE ORDER BY A.GR_NAME
Select * From PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.PR_NAME As PrNameL,A.PR_CODE as PrCodeL FROM PRODUCT_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = B.PR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.PR_NAME,A.PR_CODE ORDER BY PR_NAME

SELECT C.VCH_TYPE As VchTyp,C.VCH_NO VchNo,C.STK_DATE As StkDate,A.TAG_NO As TagNo,A.IT_CODE As ItCode,B.IT_NAME,C.TBL_CODE As Counter,C.DESIGN_NO As Design,C.ITM_SIZE As Size,C.ITM_PCS as Pcs,C.ITM_GWT As Grwt,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWt,C.LBR_AMT LbrAmt,C.OTH_AMT OthAmt, C.ITM_MRP As Mrp,C.KR_NAME As KrName,C.CO_BOOK As Book,C.BOOK_NAME As BookName,C.AC_CODE As AcCode,C.VCH_SRNO As TagId,C.BAG_WT, C.ITM_GHT_WT,C.ITM_TOUCH,C.ITM_WEST_PRC,C.ITM_FINE,C.LBR_PRC,C.LBR_TYPE,C.LBR_RATE,C.LBR_CODE from (MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO And A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO And A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND C.STK_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
